data.name: Taite
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Taite was a goddess of childbirth and deliverance. In Christianity, the name Taite is derived from the Aramaic word ‘Taitha’, meaning ‘to be steadfast’ or ‘to endure’. The name Taite is a powerful reminder of God’s deliverance and salvation.
